patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and LinkedIn Sales Navigator share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose BookYourData only if your buying job matches “Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go cre” rather than LinkedIn Sales Navigator's shape. Choose LinkedIn Sales Navigator only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — C” rather than BookYourData's shape. Workflow advantage: BookYourData leans email-outreach; LinkedIn Sales Navigator leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and LinkedIn Sales Navigator share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

- Workflow coverage skew: BookYourData-leaning email-outreach vs LinkedIn Sales Navigator-leaning —.
- Researched limits: BookYourData — none listed; LinkedIn Sales Navigator — Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info.
